run.task: Route only sofascore-browser's egress through Windscribe VPN on blackpearl.local (Unraid, docker-compose)
run.method: manual octocode CLI evidence loop (ghSearch + cache fetch materialization + gh repo view), 2026-09-15
run.precursor: automated research-orchestrator run was inconclusive (inconclusive-run1/); its probe derivation selected irrelevant repos

claims.claim: gluetun has first-class Windscribe WireGuard support with documented env vars

evidence.excerpt: # Wireguard / docker run ... -e VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=windscribe -e VPN_TYPE=wireguard -e WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY=... -e WIREGUARD_ADDRESSES="10.64.222.21/32" -e WIREGUARD_PRESHARED_KEY= -e SERVER_REGIONS=Netherlands
compose service block: gluetun / image: qmcgaw/gluetun / cap_add: NET_ADMIN / devices: /dev/net/tun + the same WIREGUARD_* envs
Required env: VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=windscribe; Build-a-Plan subscriptions need SERVER_REGIONS; WIREGUARD_ENDPOINT_PORT allowed values: 53, 80, 123, 443, 1194, 65142

claims.claim: network_mode: service:<name> is the official pattern to attach one container to gluetun; spec forbids combining it with networks:

evidence.excerpt: Same compose: 'Add network_mode: "service:gluetun" to your second container so that it uses the gluetun network stack.' External: network_mode: "container:gluetun". 'There is no need for depends_on.'

network_mode sets a service container's network mode ... service:{name}: Gives the service container access to the specified service only ... When set, the networks attribute is not allowed and Compose rejects any Compose file containing both attributes.

claims.claim: gluetun has a built-in default-on firewall kill switch, configurable input/outbound rules

evidence.excerpt: Built in firewall kill switch to allow traffic only with needed the VPN servers and LAN devices

claims.claim: gluetun runs its own DNS resolver inside its netns (tunnel-consistent DNS) and ships a health server + tunnel restart-on-failure

evidence.excerpt: DNS_SERVER (retro DOT), DNS_UPSTREAM_RESOLVER_TYPE, DNS_PLAINTEXT_ADDRESS, DNS_CACHING, DNS_UPDATE_PERIOD - unbound-based resolver settings
ServerAddress default 127.0.0.1:9999; HEALTH_SERVER_ADDRESS, HEALTH_TARGET_ADDRESSES, HEALTH_ICMP_TARGET_IPS, HEALTH_RESTART_VPN ('Restart VPN on healthcheck failure')

claims.claim: Real-world production compose examples attach tunnelled apps via network_mode and publish their ports through gluetun

evidence.excerpt: gluetun: image qmcgaw/gluetun, container_name arr-suite-gluetun, cap_add NET_ADMIN, ports 8080:8080 (qbittorrent web UI) ... qbittorrent: network_mode: container:arr-suite-gluetun # use the gluetun container network (vpn killswitch)

claims.claim: Option (b) Windscribe CLI in-container has no official image; third-party wrappers are stale

evidence.excerpt: wiorca/docker-windscribe (30 stars, pushed 2022-09-22, verified via gh repo view), BlkLeg/CircuitBreaker, dumbasPL/windscribe-ephemeral-port-torrent, Kabe0/deluge-windscribe, jay-to-the-dee/Windscribe-HTTPproxy-dockerized - all community, none official Windscribe

claims.claim: Option (c) plain WireGuard sidecar is viable (client conf drop-in) but requires hand-rolled kill switch/DNS/LAN-route handling

evidence.excerpt: server or client based on params; PEERS unset => client mode: drop .conf into /config/wg_confs; 'When routing via Wireguard from another container using the service option ... you might lose access to the containers webUI locally' with PostUp/PreDown LAN route workaround; cap_add NET_ADMIN, optional SYS_MODULE

claims.claim: Option (d) Unraid-specific: no official Windscribe Unraid template; Unraid path collapses into running gluetun as a normal Docker container

evidence.excerpt: No Windscribe Community Applications template found (empty results)
Fix the Unraid template - https://github.com/passteque/gluetun/discussions/550 (Unraid runs gluetun as a normal container)

claims.claim: The canonical gluetun repo has moved: qmcgaw/gluetun now returns 404; current code home is passteque/gluetun (image name qmcgaw/gluetun still used in wiki/examples)

evidence.excerpt: {"message": "Not Found", "status": "404"}; gh search repos gluetun -> passteque/gluetun (15506 stars)
